title: 2007 Dakar Rally
who: Won by Stéphane Peterhansel / Jean-Paul Cottret (Mitsubishi Pajero Evolution) and Cyril Despres (KTM)
summary: The 2007 edition of the Dakar Rally, in its African era: 15 stage towns and bivouacs through Portugal, Spain, Morocco, Mauritania, Mali, Senegal. Winners — Cars: Stéphane Peterhansel / Jean-Paul Cottret (Mitsubishi Pajero Evolution); Bikes: Cyril Despres (KTM); Trucks: Hans Stacey (MAN).
approximate: Stage towns and bivouacs from Wikipedia's stage table. The rally ran off-road between them, so the lines are straight from bivouac to bivouac.
